title: Trade precision for smaller totals
hook: A smaller dynamic program may optimize a rounded version of the payoff.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Scale item values before DP and separate the rounded objective from actual collected value.

misconception: Approximation requires randomly dropping items rather than controlling rounding loss.
objective: Scale item values before DP and separate the rounded objective from actual collected value.

claims.text: Scaling changes the objective that the value-indexed DP optimizes, while weights and actual collected values remain separate. The displayed rounded optimum is not the original value. A full approximation guarantee additionally needs a scale chosen for the desired error and item count.
